about: Depache RW Editor stat dictionary (phase E1b-2). A WHITELIST: a key that is not listed here is never editable. Every entry: how the game reads the key (type), where (sections), tooltip texts, hard limits (an edit outside them is refused), soft warn limits (absolute warnMin/warnMax and relative relWarnMin/relWarnMax = multiples of the value before the edit), cross-key rules and the evidence. Limits are in the entry's unit: frames (60 per second) for type time, seconds for type buildTime.
sources: Types and defaults: javap -c -p on D:/SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/Rusted Warfare/game-lib.jar (JDK 21.0.10), classes com.corrodinggames.rts.game.units.custom.ag (unit loader), bh (projectile), bn (turret), d.b (price parser) and gameFramework.utility.ab (ini reader: g/b(Integer) = Integer.parseInt, a(Float) = Float.parseFloat, b(Float) = time: 'Ns' = N*60 frames else frames, d(Float) = inverted time: 'Ns' = 1/(N*60) per frame else the number). Load-time checks: knowledge/rw-validation-strings.txt and the javap offsets named per entry. Shipped ranges: rwedit dict-check --mod src (2026-10-12). A hard limit that is NOT a game check is an editor-side bound (verified=false, PLACEHOLDERS PH-076).

rules.desc: When every turret of a unit sets limitingRange and the unit sets maxAttackRange, the largest limitingRange must not be below maxAttackRange x globalScale; otherwise the unit fails to load ('limitingRange as been applied to all turrets but is less than maxAttackRange').
rules.evidence: units/custom/ag offsets 12619-12996 (javap): local 70 = max over turrets of bn.ab (limitingRange, bn offset 1703, default 99999 = unset), error thrown when all turrets set it, maxAttackRange is set and max < as.i; as.i = maxAttackRange x l.aG (globalScale, ag offsets 1188 and 11539-11572). The editor applies it to every turret_ section (the engine only to turrets with flag bn.B, not traced), i.e. it can refuse slightly more than the game.

rules.desc: A projectile needs directDamage or areaDamage set ('directDamage or areaDamage must be set').
rules.evidence: units/custom/bh offsets 23-67 (javap): RuntimeException when both keys are null. The editor never removes a key, so an edit can only keep this rule true; it is checked anyway.

rules.desc: A turret's limitingMinRange above its limitingRange leaves no distance at which it can fire.
rules.evidence: Editor-side sanity check (no load-time check found in bn). PH-076.

rules.desc: A turret that uses energy on a unit without energy (energyMax 0 or unset) may never fire.
rules.evidence: Editor-side sanity check; the firing condition was not traced in the jar. PH-076.

entries.label: Price (credits)
entries.desc: Credits paid to build the unit.
entries.up: More expensive: fewer can be built; the AI builds it less often.
entries.down: Cheaper: easier to mass. 0 makes it free.
entries.evidence: units/custom/d/b.b (javap offsets 147-176): a bare number or 'credits=N' / 'credits:N', parts split on ',' or '|'; Integer.parseInt (whole numbers only, 'Bad price number ... (Hint: A whole number was expected)'). No range check; the upper bound is an editor bound below the Java int range.

entries.label: Price (rust)
entries.desc: Rust Point (the red resource) paid to build the unit, on top of the credits.
entries.up: Needs more rust: slower to get with normal income.
entries.evidence: units/custom/d/b.b (javap offsets 402-455): a part named after a mod resource (rust is defined in all-units.template) is Float.parseFloat. Upper bound is an editor bound.

entries.label: Health
entries.desc: Hit points: damage the unit can take before it is destroyed.
entries.up: Survives longer (stronger for the same price).
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag offset 6345 (javap): ab.g = required Integer.parseInt; no range check in the loader. hardMin 1 (0 or less = dies at once, DESIGN_EDITOR 1.4) and hardMax are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Shield
entries.desc: Shield points that absorb damage before health is lost.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag offset 6363: ab.b(Integer), default 0, no range check. Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Armour
entries.desc: Flat damage reduction applied to each hit.
entries.up: Small hits do little or no damage.
entries.down: Takes the full damage of each hit.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag (keyreads ag line 6110): ab.a(Float), no range check. Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Self repair
entries.desc: Health the unit repairs by itself over time.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag offset 8087: ab.a(Float), default 0, no range check. Negative values drain health (shipped: dying-unit templates -150 .. -5). Unit (per frame) not traced; bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Build time
entries.desc: How long the unit takes to build. Written as 'Ns' (N seconds) or as progress per frame.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 5137: ab.d (inverted time, gameFramework/utility/ab offsets 2328-2403): 'Ns' -> 1/(N*60) progress per frame, a plain number = progress per frame. 0s would divide by zero; hardMin 0.1 s and hardMax 10 h are editor bounds.

entries.label: Credits produced
entries.desc: Credits this unit or building earns for its owner by itself, as the mod's descriptions say 'per second' (Generator T1 = 2). Typed on a unit or building that has none, it adds the line so that one earns too (the game reads this line for every unit; confirm in a match).
entries.up: Earns more: faster economy, stronger snowballing for whoever owns it.
entries.down: Earns less. 0 = nothing. Below 0 the unit COSTS credits every second (Fabricator Alt does this on purpose: it turns credits into rust).
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag offset 4255 (javap): generation_resources is read by d/b.a(l, ab, key, section, Z) -> d/b.b(l, String): parts split on ',' or '|', 'name=value' or 'name:value', credits = Integer.parseInt (b.b offsets 147-176). The loader reads the line for every unit, with no building-only branch at these offsets (that a mobile unit really pays out in a match is not yet seen in the game, PH-096). 'Per second' is the mod's own wording (Generator T1 'credits=2' = 'Generates 2 credits per second', generation_delay default 40 at ag offset 4313); the exact tick rate was not traced. The range -1000000 .. 1000000 and the 5000 soft limit are editor bounds (PH-076); negative values are real: fabricatorAltT1..T3 ship credits=-30 / -75 / -180 together with rust=+10 / +25 / +60. Keys the line already holds (rust=, energy=) are kept; a line written with ${...} is read-only.

entries.label: Rust produced
entries.desc: Rust Point (the red resource) this unit or building produces by itself (Command Center T1 = 15). Typed on a unit that has none, it adds the line (confirm in a match).
entries.up: More rust: more rust-priced units and upgrades.
entries.down: Less rust. 0 = none. Below 0 it uses rust up every second.
entries.evidence: Same line as core.generation_resources.credits: a part named after a mod resource (rust is defined in all-units.template) is Float.parseFloat (d/b.b offsets 402-455, as for price). Shipped examples: command_center.ini 'credits=60, rust=15', ACV core 'rust=${rustProvided1}' (expression: read-only). The rate wording and bounds are as for the credits part (the survey's largest shipped value is 100000).

entries.label: Tech level provided
entries.desc: How much tech level this building (or unit) adds to its owner while it stands. Tech levels ADD UP across everything the player owns; things unlock when the sum reaches their requirement (2, 4, 8 ... 70 in this mod). Tech Center T1/T2/T3 provide 1/4/15.
entries.up: Unlocks higher-tier buildings and upgrades sooner (one building can carry the whole tech tree).
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag offset 4237 (javap): borrowResourcesWhileBuilt is read by d/b.a(l, ab, key, section, Z) -> d/b.b (price-format parts, non-credits = Float.parseFloat). The mod stores a PROVIDED amount as a negative borrow: tech_center.ini 'borrowResourcesWhileBuilt: techLevel = ${-1*techT1ProvideTechLevel}', neutralTechCenter 'techLevel = -3*...', 'techLevel = -500' (so the editor shows N and writes -N; negate=true). That the engine adds a negative borrow to the player's pool is the mod author's design (tech requirements 2..70 in all-units.template, isLockedAlt2Message 'Tech level requirement'); not traced in the jar. NOT the same key as [core] techLevel (the unit's own 1..3 class, ag offset 4112, never editable). hardMax 100000 and the 1000 soft limit are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Speed
entries.desc: Top movement speed.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 7808: ab.a(Float), no range check. Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Attack range
entries.desc: Distance at which the unit starts to attack.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag offsets 11539-11572: ab.a(Float), multiplied by globalScale; no range check. Negative values are shipped on fake bodies that never attack (orbitalGunFakeBody -40, offSatFakeBody -50). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Direct damage
entries.desc: Damage dealt to the unit that is hit.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bh offsets 20 and 83 (javap): ab.b(Integer) (whole numbers only); 'directDamage or areaDamage must be set'. Negative values are allowed by the parser (warned: they heal). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Area damage
entries.desc: Damage dealt to every unit inside the blast radius.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bh offsets 26 and 93: ab.b(Integer). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Reload time
entries.desc: Time between two shots of this turret (frames, or 'Ns' for seconds).
entries.shippedOutsideHard: hades (experimental_groundeffect_vehicles/groundeffect_bomber/groundeffect_bomber.ini [turret_1], copied to turret_2..5) ships delay 0; DESIGN_EDITOR 1.4 refuses 0 (fires every frame) on purpose: the shipped value stays, an edit must pick 1 frame or more.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bn line 729: ab.b(Float) = time ('Ns' or frames). hardMin 1 frame (0 = fires every frame, DESIGN_EDITOR 1.4) and hardMax 1 hour are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Shield recharge
entries.desc: How fast the shield recharges.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 6082: ab.a(Float), default 0.25. Negative values drain the shield (shipped: -425 .. -6). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Energy capacity
entries.desc: Energy the unit can store (used by abilities and energy weapons).
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 6129: ab.a(Float). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Energy recharge
entries.desc: Energy regained over time.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 6147: ab.a(Float). Negative values drain energy (shipped: -100 .. -0.001). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Build/repair range
entries.desc: Distance at which a builder can build or repair.
entries.up: Builds and repairs from further away.
entries.down: Must get closer to build or repair.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 6611: ab.b(Integer). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Build power
entries.desc: How fast this builder builds other units (multiplier).
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 6756: ab.a(Float). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Factory speed
entries.desc: How fast this factory produces units (multiplier).
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 6766: ab.a(Float). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Mass
entries.desc: Weight used when units push each other.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag offset 5041: ab.g = required Integer.parseInt (shipped up to 1000000000 = practically immovable). hardMax stays below the Java int range. Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Sight range
entries.desc: How far the unit sees through the fog of war.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag offset 6968: ab.b(Integer), default 15. Unit 'tiles' inferred from the default; bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Extra income (credits)
entries.desc: A second, separate way to give credits every income tick: it is added to 'Credits produced' (generation_resources). Most units use 'Credits produced' instead.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag offset 4269: ab.b(Integer), default 0, added to generation_resources. Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Income interval
entries.desc: Frames between two income ticks.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag offset 4313: ab.b(Integer), default 40; the loader refuses < 0 ('generation_delay cannot be < 0'). hardMin 1 (0 is special-cased at offset 4335, not traced) and hardMax are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Acceleration
entries.desc: How quickly the unit reaches top speed.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 7820: ab.a(Float) (shipped up to 1000 on support-ability aircraft = instant). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Braking
entries.desc: How quickly the unit stops.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 7832: ab.a(Float). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Reverse speed
entries.desc: Speed when driving backwards, as a fraction of top speed (0.6 = 60 %).
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 7908: ab.a(Float), default 0.6. hardMax 1 (= forward speed) is an editor bound (PH-076).

entries.label: Attack delay
entries.desc: Unit-wide delay between attacks (frames, or 'Ns'); turrets may set their own reload time.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 8238: ab.b(Float) time, default 50 frames. Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Turret turn speed
entries.desc: How fast the unit's turrets rotate (default for all turrets).
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 8108: ab.a(Float), default 8. Unit inferred; bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Aim spread
entries.desc: Random aim error of the unit's attacks.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag line 8229: ab.a(Float), default 0.6. Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Warm-up time
entries.desc: Time the turret charges before the first shot (frames, or 'Ns').
entries.evidence: units/custom/bn line 750: ab.b(Float) time. Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Turret turn speed
entries.desc: How fast this turret rotates.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bn line 1275: ab.a(Float) (shipped up to 1000 = turns at once). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Turret max range
entries.desc: Furthest distance this turret may fire at.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bn offset 1703: ab.a(Float), default 99999 (= unset, ag offset 12749). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Turret min range
entries.desc: Closest distance this turret may fire at (artillery dead zone).
entries.up: Larger dead zone near the unit.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bn offset 1747: ab.a(Float). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Energy per shot
entries.desc: Energy this turret uses for each shot.
entries.down: Fires longer on its energy. 0 = free.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bn line 828: ab.a(Float). Negative values give energy (shipped: hero torpedo turrets -1). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Turret aim spread
entries.desc: Random aim error of this turret.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bn line 1405: ab.a(Float). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Blast radius
entries.desc: Radius in which area damage is dealt.
entries.up: Hits more units per shot (and costs more CPU).
entries.evidence: units/custom/bh line 70: ab.b(Integer). hardMax is an editor bound against CPU load (DESIGN_EDITOR 1.4; PH-076).

entries.label: Projectile speed
entries.desc: How fast the projectile flies.
entries.up: Reaches the target sooner; harder to dodge.
entries.down: Slower shots; moving targets can dodge.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bh line 246: ab.a(Float). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Projectile lifetime
entries.desc: How long the projectile exists before it disappears (frames, or 'Ns').
entries.up: Flies further before vanishing (very long lives with slow shots can pile up).
entries.evidence: units/custom/bh offset 460: ab.h = required time; 0 is shipped on fake / notify projectiles that vanish at once. warnMax 1 minute and hardMax 1 hour are an editor bound (runaway projectiles, crashes.txt OutOfMemoryError 2025-09-25; DESIGN_EDITOR 1.4; PH-076).

entries.label: Deflection power
entries.desc: How hard this projectile is to deflect by shields that deflect shots.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bh line 190: ab.a(Float); all-units.template sets -1 (shipped default). Meaning inferred from the name; bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Armour piercing
entries.desc: Armour of the target this projectile ignores.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bh line 1203: ab.a(Float). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Ground spread
entries.desc: Random spread of shots fired at the ground.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bh line 1103: ab.a(Float). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Homing turn speed
entries.desc: How sharply a guided projectile can turn toward its target.
entries.evidence: units/custom/bh offset 1496: ab.a(Float) (shipped up to 9999 = no turning limit). Bounds are editor bounds (PH-076).

entries.label: Action price (credits)
entries.desc: Credits an action (an upgrade or ability button) costs.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag offsets 288 / 1455 of the action reader: '<prefix>price' through units/custom/d/b (same format as the unit price). Bounds are editor bounds.

entries.label: Action price (rust)
entries.desc: Rust an action costs.
entries.evidence: Same parser as action.price.credits; rust is a mod resource (Float.parseFloat). Bounds are editor bounds.

entries.label: Action time
entries.desc: How long an action (for example an upgrade) takes. 'Ns' = N seconds.
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag action reader offset 3386: '<prefix>buildSpeed' through ab.d (inverted time). '0s' (very common on info / switch actions) = 1/(0*60) progress per frame = done at once (inferred from ab.d, PH-077); a plain 0 is read-only. Bounds are editor bounds.

entries.label: Gives credits
entries.desc: Credits an action adds (negative = takes).
entries.down: The action gives less (negative takes credits).
entries.evidence: units/custom/ag action reader offsets 667-677: '<prefix>addResources' through units/custom/d/b (price format). Bounds are editor bounds.

entries.label: Gives rust
entries.desc: Rust an action adds (negative = takes).
entries.evidence: Same parser as action.addResources.credits. Bounds are editor bounds.
